title: Local output-module fine-tuning demonstrated for Qwen 3.8 122B in Strata
summary: A local fine-tuning workflow runs Qwen 3.8 122B on 16 GB VRAM and 64 GB RAM by freezing 48 main layers, caching activations on GPU, and training a 12.54 MiB output module on CPU.
research_notes:
Deploy the base Qwen 3.8 122B model inside the Strata inference engine on a workstation with at least 16 GB VRAM and 64 GB system RAM.

Freeze the 48 main transformer layers and route training dialogues through the GPU forward pass to cache intermediate activations.

Execute SFT and DPO training on CPU exclusively targeting the 12.54 MiB output module.

Validate behavioral updates against the laboratory agent and maintain the rollback script to revert output-module modifications if regressions occur.

Cache forward-pass activations on the GPU before initiating CPU training to prevent VRAM exhaustion and avoid full backpropagation through frozen layers.

Maintain automated rollback scripts to restore base output-module weights immediately if specialized agent evaluations degrade.

Limit local CPU fine-tuning iterations to lightweight alignment passes such as SFT and DPO to keep cycle duration around one minute.
